readme.text:
# HuniePopArchipelago Collection of projects for connecting/tracking HuniePop with Archipelago # HuniePopArchipelagoClient Built using template from https://github.com/alwaysintreble/ArchipelagoBepInExPluginTemplate Requires Hunie Pop APWorld (found in releases) to generate a world A BepInEx plugin for Hunie Pop to connect and talk to a Archipelago server for multiworld randomization games Note items are processed when moving between locations
F8 will bring up a console to interact with AP server and view logs BACKUP YOUR SAVE FILE BEFORE USING THIS AS I CANT GUARANTEE THAT IT WILL NOT CORRUPT IT (also is a good idea to back up your saves when modding any game) - Windows save location: "C:/Users/{YOUR USERNAME}/AppData/LocalLow/HuniePot/HuniePop/" - Mac save location: "/Users/{YOUR USERNAME}/Library/Application Support/com.HuniePot.HuniePop/" INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS: - Have Hunie Pop Installed - Download Hunie Pop Archipelago plugin (See Releases for latest version) - Extract and copy the contents of "Hunie Pop Archipelago plugin.zip" to the directory where "HuniePop.exe" is if it asks you to overwrite files click yes NOTE if you get a game crash when starting the game make sure that in "{huniepop game directory}/bepinex/config/bepinex.cfg" the 2nd last option is "type = MonoBehaviour" not "type = Application" if you get "An invalid SSL record was received" error try putting "ws://" or "wss://" before the host address # HuniePopArchipelago APWorld APWorld For Hunie Pop Tutorials for setting up and starting a Archipelago world/server https://archipelago.gg/tutorial/ Locations checked: - gifting girls gifts (18 general, 6 unique per girl, 288 total) - taking girls on dates (4 per girl, 48 total) - sleeping with girls (complete a date at night) (1 per girl, 12 total) - giving kyu girls panties (1 per girl, 12 total) - learning their details (12 per girl, 144 total) items implemented: - unlock condition for each girl (12 total) - girl panties (12 total) - gift items(18 general, 6 unique per girl 288 total) - talent/romance/flirtation/sexuality/passion/sensitivity/charisma/luck token level up items (6 each type, 48 total) (Note you can not level up these any other way) goals: - give kyu all available panties - sleep with all avaliable girls # Hunie Pop Archipelago PopTracker Plugin Item tracker for Hunie Pop Archipelago ## Installation Just download the latest build or source and put in your packs folder.

notes.text:
- (Client) Fixed locations checked in main menu not correctly showing - (Client) Fixed shop items reappearing after save/quit - (Client) Fixes issue with save game not saving at correct time resulting in missing locations/items in game V3.0.1 Changelog - (APWorld) Fixed Issue with connecting with Universal Tracker - (APWorld) fixed typos in hunie_to_muney YMAL option - (Client) Fixed Errors if save file was not present after connecting to a slot - (Client) Added Connecting screen while trying to connect to a server - (Client) fixed sending locations causing game freezing - (Client) properly send goal location in case server has auto release disabled V3.0.0 Changelog - (Client) Swapped networking from DotsWebsocket/CursedArchipelagoClient to Archipelago.MultiClient.Net/c-wspp-websocket-sharp - - playing on Linux should now work through wine/proton (will work on trying to get native Linux to work later) - (Apworld/Client) added option/logic for disabling girl questions - (Apworld/Client) added option/logic for disabling girl gifts - (Apworld/Client) added option/logic for locking shop slots behind getting "Shop Pass" items - (APWorld) moved logic over to Rule Builder - (Client) Save file is now stored server side through datastorage - (Client) added the ability to convert hunie to money through the shop the ratio can be changed through YMAL option - (Client) when talking to a girl you have a >50% change to be asked a question if you haven't learned all their details - (Client) Added code "$toggledeathlink" to toggle deathlink off/on HOTFIX - disable cheats used in dev

CLIENT INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS: - Have Hunie Pop Installed - Download Hunie Pop Archipelago plugin (See Releases for latest version) - Extract and copy the contents of "Hunie Pop Archipelago plugin.zip" to the directory where "HuniePop.exe" is if it asks you to overwrite files click yes - NOTE if you get a game crash when starting the game make sure that in "{huniepop game directory}/BepInEx/config/BepInEx.cfg" the 2nd last option is "type = MonoBehaviour" not "type = Application" APWORLD INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS: - Have Archipelago Launcher Installed (latest release found here: https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases/latest ) - Download Huniepop APWorld (See Releases for latest version) - Select "Install APWorld" in launcher and select Huniepop APWorld you downloaded - Restart launcher for APWorld to properly install - (Optional but Recomended)Select "Generate Template Options" to generate default Huniepop YMAL POPTRACKER INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS: - copy "Hunie Pop Archipelago poptracker.zip" to your poptracker "packs" folder
